instructions: Solve the assigned coding exercise. Return only the requested Python function. No tools are available.

input.text:
Return only one Python function, with no Markdown fences or explanatory prose. Use integer/bool literals, local assignment, if/else, return, comparisons, and/or/not, conditional expressions, +, -, *, //, %, and bitwise & only. No calls (including min/max), imports, loops, shifts, exponentiation, decorators, helper functions, containers or strings. Keep the source under 4096 bytes. These are local Python reference tasks, not native OS validation.

Inputs are integers. Reject any input outside 0..65535 by returning -1. Write overlap_size(a_start: int, a_end: int, b_start: int, b_end: int) -> int. Reject an end smaller than its start. Return the number of integer positions in the intersection of half-open intervals [a_start,a_end) and [b_start,b_end). Empty intervals and touching endpoints have zero overlap.
